summary.text: Phillip A. Scott is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 63rd District, which covers part of Orange County and part of Spotsylvania County, and has served since 2022.
Scott sits on the House committees on Education, Privileges and Elections and Health and Human Services.

paragraphs.text: Phillip A. Scott was born in Voorhees, NJ, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Scott's education as Liberty University (B.S., Religion, 2010; M.A., Management and Leadership, 2013; J.M., American Legal Studies, 2019).
The profile gives Scott's occupation as team manager.
Scott's listed memberships and affiliations include Lake Wilderness Property Owners' Association (director); Spotsylvania County Citizens Budget Review Committee.
